title: HiBob Review (2026)
intro: HiBob is evaluated here as a core HRIS / employee system of record — HiBob (product brand Bob) is a modular HRIS for distributed mid-market companies: employee system of record, time off, workflows, analytics, and mobile, with optional hiring, payroll (US/UK), talent, compensation, learning, and time & attendance modules. Every subscription includes Bob Core (including AI Companion). Pricing is custom PEPM plus implementation — no published USD floor, free plan, or self-serve trial. Demo / pricing request only. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s HR methodology (ease of use, hiring/workforce fit, workflow depth, integrations, mobile/frontline, analytics, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose HiBob when a culture-forward mid-market HRIS with modular talent/payroll is the job and you will take a PEPM quote — not when you need published SMB PEPM, EU-first Personio, or frontline WFM.
verdict: Choose HiBob when a culture-forward mid-market HRIS with modular talent/payroll is the job and you will take a PEPM quote — not when you need published SMB PEPM, EU-first Personio, or frontline WFM. Compare BambooHR for published PEPM, Personio for EU GDPR-native HRIS, Rippling for HR+IT unification, and Workday for enterprise HCM. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Culture-forward HRIS UX is the mid-market shortlist reason versus Workday weight. Not lab-tested.
Primary job is core HRIS for distributed growth companies. Scored inside hris-core, not as ATS or WFM.
Core people admin plus modular talent/payroll is deep. Held at 8 vs Rippling’s IT graph.
Marketplace and collaboration connectors are strong for a mid-market HRIS.
Employee mobile is solid; not a deskless WFM app.
People analytics in Core plus module insights are adequate mid-market.
Modular path from <200 toward 1,000+ is the vendor thesis; still not enterprise HCM.
Opaque PEPM and module stacking depress value versus BambooHR’s published $10 floor. Affiliate economics excluded.
Bob AI Companion included in Core is a real included-AI story versus add-on-only suites.
